text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reconstruct props seen in input drama reference frames as a clean catalog asset board. 3 columns 2 rows exactly 6 cells. Soft refined physically plausible 3D fantasy prop rendering matching references, not cartoon. Each cell one listed object or coherent set, complete object visible with ample margin. No people, hands, bodies, scenery, labels, watermark, oily shine or excessive gold lighting. Independent props only.
